data.name: Monotosh
data.gender_notes: Monotosh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Monotosh is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, meaning 'Moon God'. In Hindu mythology, the moon is considered a celestial body that represents knowledge, power, and fertility. The name Monotosh is believed to bring blessings of knowledge, wisdom, and prosperity. The name Monotosh carries the meaning “Moon God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Monotosh usually hope their child will grow to embody moon god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name connected to the divine power of the Moon.
data.etymology: Monotosh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Monotosh total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Monotosh is deeply rooted in Hindu culture, reflecting the reverence for celestial bodies, particularly the moon. It pays homage to the belief that the moon governs the well-being of its people and represents the gentle, changing, and sometimes unpredictable nature of life.
data.spiritual_significance: Monotosh, as a name that signifies the Moon God, is believed to bring spiritual blessings related to knowledge (Gyan Dan) wisdom (Buddhi), and prosperity (Dhan). The name carries a powerful spiritual aura associated with inner illumination, intuition, and adaptation in the face of life's challenges.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Monotosh is a name derived from the Sanskrit words 'mono' meaning one and 'tosh' meaning pleasure or desire. It symbolizes the pursuit of singular, unwavering devotion towards a chosen goal or desire.

historical_references.reference: Monotosh was a 15th century Bengali poet and philosopher, renowned for his works in the Bengali language. He is widely regarded as one of the greatest poets in Bengali literature. Monotosh wrote extensively on the themes of love, nature, and spirituality.

Monotosh is also known as Lalon Fakir, a 19th century mystic poet and philosopher from Bangladesh. He is considered a pioneer of the Baul tradition of Hindu mysticism in Bengal. His songs, known as 'Geet', express deep spiritual longing and are often sung in trances.

modern_usage.modern_context: Monotosh is a name of Hindu origin, often seen in modern contexts related to technology, gaming, and pop culture. In the gaming world, Monotosh is a common name for characters in indie games, particularly those with a mystical or spiritual theme. Lastly, in pop culture, Monotosh has been referenced in memes, fan art, and cosplay, often in a tongue-in-cheek or ironic manner due to its unique and exotic sounding nature.
